api.description: Coordinator JSON-RPC and observability API settings.

api.json-rpc-path.description: HTTP path the JSON-RPC API is served on.

api.json-rpc-port.description: Port serving the coordinator JSON-RPC API. 0 picks a random free port.

api.json-rpc-server-verticles.description: Number of Vert.x verticles serving the JSON-RPC API.

conflation.description: Block conflation, blob compression, and proof aggregation settings.

conflation.backtesting-directory.description: Directory used to persist conflation backtesting data. Omit to disable backtesting output.

conflation.blob-compression.batches-limi.description: Maximum number of batches per blob. Omit for no explicit limit.

conflation.blob-compression.blob-size-li.description: Maximum compressed blob size in bytes before a blob is finalized.

conflation.blob-compression.handler-poll.description: Interval between blob compression handler runs.

conflation.blocks-limit.description: Maximum number of L2 blocks in a single conflation. Omit for no block-count limit.

conflation.conflation-deadline.description: Maximum time to wait before conflating available blocks even if limits are not reached. Omit to disable deadline-based conflation.

conflation.conflation-deadline-check-int.description: How often to check whether the conflation deadline has elapsed.

conflation.conflation-deadline-last-bloc.description: Delay after the last block before confirming it, to absorb short reorgs.

conflation.consistent-number-of-blocks-o.description: Number of L1 blocks to wait for consistency (finality safety margin); defaults to one epoch.

conflation.force-stop-conflation-at-bloc.description: Inclusive L2 block number at which to stop conflating. Omit to conflate indefinitely.
Inclusive block timestamp at which to stop conflating. Omit to conflate indefinitely.

conflation.l2-endpoint.description: L2 endpoint used for conflation. Falls back to defaults.l2-endpoint.

conflation.l2-fetch-blocks-limit.description: Maximum number of L2 blocks to fetch that are unproven and held in memory. Omit for no limit.

conflation.l2-logs-endpoint.description: L2 endpoint used for eth_getLogs during conflation. Falls back to l2-endpoint/defaults.

conflation.l2-request-retries.description: Retry policy for L2 conflation requests; falls back to defaults.l2-request-retries.

conflation.l2-request-retries.failures-w.description: Number of consecutive failures after which warning logs start being emitted. Omit to use the default threshold.

conflation.l2-request-retries.ignore-fir.description: Grace period during which initial failures are ignored (not logged/counted) before retries are treated as errors. Omit to disable.

conflation.l2-request-retries.max-retrie.description: Maximum number of retry attempts. Omit for endless retries.

conflation.l2-request-retries.timeout.description: Overall timeout across all retry attempts. Omit to disable the timeout.

conflation.new-blocks-polling-interval.description: Interval between polls for new L2 blocks.

conflation.proof-aggregation.aggregation.description: Aggregations are only closed when their size is a multiple of this value.

conflation.proof-aggregation.blobs-limit.description: Maximum number of blobs in a single aggregation. Omit for no explicit limit.

conflation.proof-aggregation.coordinator.description: Interval between coordinator polls for new proofs to aggregate.

conflation.proof-aggregation.deadline.description: Maximum time to wait before aggregating available proofs. Omit to disable deadline-based aggregation (wait indefinitely).

conflation.proof-aggregation.deadline-ch.description: How often to check whether the aggregation deadline has elapsed.

conflation.proof-aggregation.proofs-limi.description: Maximum number of proofs in a single aggregation.

conflation.proof-aggregation.target-end-.description: L2 block numbers that must end an aggregation (e.g. hard-fork boundaries). Omit for none.

conflation.proof-aggregation.timestamp-b.description: Timestamps that force an aggregation boundary (e.g. timestamp-based hard forks).

conflation.proof-aggregation.wait-api-re.description: Whether to wait for the API to resume after the target block before aggregating.

conflation.proof-aggregation.wait-for-no.description: Whether to wait for a period of no L2 activity before triggering an aggregation.

conflation.proof-aggregation.wait-target.description: Whether to wait for the target block to be finalized on L1 before aggregating.
